row.name: MSG Rangers Corp. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)
checks.note: the session before the burst was up and not narrow

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=3 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.33 tightness=0.6 base_volume_vs_leg=0.47 base_volume_vs_avg=0.54
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 37.4% in 10 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The RE check is a recorded FAIL — the burst bar's range of 5.7% is only 0.58× the largest of the prior five bars, meaning the signal day did not expand meaningfully over recent volatility. Visually the burst bar is a solid green close near the high, but the prior leg contains a very large single-day gap bar (the Oct 29 candle) that dominates the leg's gain, making the advance look more like one gap plus drift than persistent stair-step buying. Volume on the signal day is also well below the 50-session average (0.46×) and ranks only 13th of the last 60 sessions, limiting conviction.
claude.key_risk: The prior leg is gap-dominated rather than a smooth stair-step advance, and the burst bar fails range expansion against recent bars, so follow-through buying may not materialize.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps more than 1% above the signal close or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's high around 232.
